problem_type: Credential validity conflated with network availability
symptom: Offline users cannot save credentials; CI canvas walkthroughs fail at key save
direct_cause: Every unsuccessful model-list probe throws before persistence
class_root: Missing distinction between explicit authentication rejection and inconclusive connectivity evidence
internal_only_reason: Candidate validation and atomic publication are internal invariants; reuse the existing non-spending model-list probe without changing provider contracts.
invariants: Explicit authentication rejection leaves old credential and connection untouched.
Inconclusive probes allow encrypted saving with persistent verificationPending; successful revalidation clears only the current credential marker.
Credential verification never grants model execution certification.
generality_proof: All renderer saves share the candidate validator and encrypted persistence; pending revalidation uses the same validator and compares the entire credential/connection snapshot before clearing.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate candidate then perform the existing atomic store write
Deduplicate concurrent pre-call probes; reject stale evidence; clear only verificationPending on success.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Awaits validated main IPC, no prior vendor mutation
Internal certification and catalog import transactions are distinct from interactive replacement; existing publication and encrypted persistence semantics retained.
Pending credential revalidation precedes executable model resolution for canvas, storyboard and ordinary generation.
Streaming text entry revalidates before resolving key.

Certification loads await the same revalidation owner before sending requests. Disabled saved keys cannot execute via published Agent or production-run resolvers; certification promotion replaces the record only after successful actual model requests.

recurrence.reason: Every offline session or supplier outage can trigger the same incorrect rejection.
same_class_scan: rg upsertVendorApiKey found three renderer saves; rg applyApiKeyUpsert found internal import and certification transactions.

prevention.invariant: Only explicit auth failure blocks saving; inconclusive results remain persistently pending until a current successful probe.
prevention.failure_mode: 401/403 and stale snapshots reject; unavailable probes preserve a visible pending marker.
prevention.strategy: Separate auth evidence from availability at the shared validator and persist pending status atomically with encrypted key material.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove unvalidated synchronous IPC writes and preemptive vendor disable.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse the existing connectivity probe; no dependency change.

migration: Existing records retain existing behavior; new offline saves persist a boolean marker, never plaintext.
residual_risks: Model-list success establishes credential reachability only, not model certification; unsupported probes remain pending.
